item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:25 HKT 16/Nov/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be mainly fine, and warm during the day over the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. A cold front is expected to reach the coast of Guangdong between Monday night and early Tuesday. Under the influence of the associated intense northeast monsoon and a broad band of clouds, it will be windy and becoming appreciably cooler over the region midweek this week, and cold over inland areas. With the monsoon moderating slightly in the latter part of this week, temperatures over the coast of southern China will rise gradually.
